bio_en: Yegor Ter-Avetikian was born on 13 January 1867 in Banants in the Ganja district; his brother was an Armenian deputy in the Russian State Duma. He studied at the universities of Geneva and in Belgium, worked closely with Kristapor Mikaelian and the Droshak editors in Geneva, then trained as a Russian officer; wounded and captured in the Russo-Japanese war, he later rose to the rank of colonel. At the end of 1915, on Rostom's instruction, he joined Dro's regiment in Bayazit-Alashkert, and in 1919-21 he served the Republic of Armenia, clearing Daralagyaz and Sisian of Bolshevik forces.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Year of death not given in the text read (died 4 February of an unstated year).
